name: Hammond Power Solutions Inc.

profile.end_markets: US & Mexico 70–84% of sales (2025: 70.3% FY, Q2 2026: 84.0%), Canada, India; electrical distributors & private label, OEMs, data centers (large custom orders 2025–26), industrial, utility/renewables

plants.products: active harmonic filters, induction heating power supplies
control & low-voltage transformers, DC power supplies

plants.city: Guadalupe (Monterrey), NL — two sites (HPS S.A. de C.V.; HPS Latin America)
plants.products: dry-type transformers incl. custom power transformers (largest production capacity per 2025 AR)
liquid-filled transformers for Indian domestic & SE Asian markets (2–4% of sales)
UPS, rectifiers, battery chargers, power conversion

profile.products: Standard and custom-designed dry-type transformers, power-quality products (harmonic-mitigating technology, active harmonic filters via Mesta 2021) and related magnetics incl. control & low-voltage transformers (Micron, Q4 2024) and induction heating; custom power transformer capacity in Mexico (most production capacity now in Mexico, then Canada and the U.S.). India plant mainly liquid-filled transformers for Indian domestic & Southeast Asian markets. From 2026-06-29 AEG Power Solutions adds AC/DC UPS, battery chargers, rectifiers & power conversion (not transformers). Single operating segment: "a manufacturer of transformers" (2025 AR Note 26; MD&A "Who We Are").
